$Auto-cuts on first open (and after Reset):\n\n- register clock/reset nets, controlled by `svsch.autocut-clk-reset` (default `true`)\n- nets carrying UHDM `declaredNetName` metadata\n- persists cuts through the existing manual-cut layout path\n\nVerification:\n- `npm run lint`\n- focused auto-cut unit tests (2 passed)\n- broader merge/layout run: 65 passed; 2 existing parser-backed tests could not run without bundled Surelog\n\nCloses #94

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Automatically creates an initial module diagram layout when none is saved.
  * Automatically cuts declared nets and register clock/reset connections for clearer diagrams.
  * Added a setting to enable or disable automatic clock/reset cuts.
  * Resetting a layout reapplies the automatic cutting rules.

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved diagram handling around generate regions and cut connections.
  * Prevented overlapping automatic cut labels.
  * Improved label positioning while moving diagram elements.

* **Tests**
  * Added coverage for initial layouts, automatic cuts, configuration behavior, and layout resets.

head_commit.message:
Throw when viewport stability poll never settles

CodeRabbit flagged that waitForViewportToSettle silently continued
past the 100-poll loop even if the React Flow transform never
stabilized, letting screenshots race an unsettled viewport.

pull_request.body:
## Summary
- Removed the always-visible diagnostics `<aside>` panel from `main.tsx`/`styles.css`.
- Added a warning-presence icon (⚠) to the toolbar's status-indicator area, mutually exclusive with the busy spinner — shown when idle and `view.diagnostics` has entries, hidden otherwise.
- No warning text/count breakdown in the UI; a hover tooltip shows just the count (e.g. "3 warnings").
- Diagnostic data pipeline (`DesignGraph.diagnostics`, `buildViewModel()`, `postView()`) is untouched, per issue scope.

## Test plan
- [x] `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.webview.json` — passes
- [x] `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.extension.json` — passes
- [x] `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.cli.json` — passes
- [x] `CI=true npx vite build` — builds cleanly
- [x] `npx vitest run` — same pass/fail counts as master (128 pre-existing parser-backend failures unrelated to this change, due to missing compiled backend binary in this environment; verified identical on master before my changes)

Closes #119

  * Improved diagram screenshot reliability by waiting for the viewport to settle before capture.
